# PDF extraction fixture

`chromium-text.pdf` contains only the synthetic heading and sentence used by the extraction regression test:

> Experiment brief
>
> A comparison group is required before attributing the improvement to the research board.

The filename is retained for compatibility with the original test. The current file is generated by ReportLab, rather than Chromium, and embeds a subset of the unmodified **Liberation Sans Regular** font supplied in `pdfjs-dist/standard_fonts/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf`. No operating-system font is embedded.

The font is distributed under the **SIL Open Font License 1.1**. Its upstream copyright and full license are preserved unchanged in [LICENSE_LIBERATION](LICENSE_LIBERATION). The synthetic fixture text and generator are part of Acadia under the repository's MIT license; the font retains its own license.

To regenerate after installing the project's locked npm dependencies and Python's `reportlab` package:

```sh
python3 scripts/create-pdf-fixture.py
```

Run that command from the repository root, then run `npm test -- tests/pdf-extraction.test.ts`. The generator uses deterministic PDF metadata and an explicitly registered font. Review regenerated text and font resources before committing the fixture.
